# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pihole-mcp docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool accepts an optional `instance`. Read tools are always available; change tools (marked **writes**) are registered only when `writes.enabled` is true and are two-step: call without `confirm_token` to preview, then repeat with the returned token.

| [`client_activity`](#client_activity) | read-only | Device activity profile |
| [`explain_domain`](#explain_domain) | read-only | Explain a domain |

| [`list_blocklists`](#list_blocklists) | read-only | List block lists |
| [`list_devices`](#list_devices) | read-only | List devices |
| [`list_domain_rules`](#list_domain_rules) | read-only | List allow/deny rules |
| [`list_instances`](#list_instances) | read-only | List Pi-hole instances |

## add_blocklist

Subscribe to a new block list URL. Run update_gravity afterwards to download it. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | yes | List URL (http or https) |
| `comment` | string |  | Comment stored with the list |
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Enable immediately (default true) |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `type` | string |  | block (default) or allow |

## add_domain_rule

Add an exact or regex allow/deny rule. The preview estimates how many recent queries it would affect. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string |  | Comment stored with the rule |
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `domain` | string | yes | Domain (exact) or regular expression |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `kind` | string |  | exact (default) or regex |
| `type` | string | yes | allow or deny |

## assess_blocklists

Health review of block lists and rules: failed or stale lists, empty or messy lists, duplicates, over-broad allow regexes, and (from a sample of the most-blocked domains) lists that contribute nothing or are fully overlapped by others. Returns findings with evidence; you write the advice.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Window used to pick the most-blocked domains to sample (default 7d) |
| `sample` | integer |  | How many top-blocked domains to attribute to lists (0-200, default 50; 0 skips attribution) |

## blocked_by_device

Which domains were blocked and which devices requested them (domain × device matrix). Answers 'which sites get blocked most, and by which devices?'. Optional domain/client filters.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | string |  | Only this device (IP or name) |
| `devices_per_domain` | integer |  | Devices listed per domain (1-20, default 5) |
| `domain` | string |  | Only this domain (Pi-hole filter; * wildcards supported) |
| `domains` | integer |  | How many blocked domains to return (1-100, default 20) |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 24h, 7d (default 24h) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |

## client_activity

Profile of one device: totals, block ratio, top allowed and blocked domains, query types and active hours.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | string | yes | Device IP address or host name |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 24h, 7d (default 24h) |
| `top` | integer |  | How many top domains per list (1-50, default 10) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |

## explain_domain

Why a domain is or is not blocked: matching block lists and allow/deny rules, plus recent queries and the devices that made them.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string | yes | Domain name to explain, e.g. ads.example.com |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Window for recent queries (default 24h) |

## get_pihole_messages

FTL diagnostic messages (warnings about misconfiguration, database problems, etc.) exactly as Pi-hole reports them.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |

## get_summary

Totals for a time window: queries, blocked, percent blocked, cache/forwarded counts, unique domains, active clients and the size of the gravity (block) database.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window ending now, e.g. 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d (default 24h) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 (default now) |

## list_blocklists

All subscribed block/allow lists with domain counts, status, last update and whether they are enabled.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |

## list_devices

Network devices Pi-hole has seen: addresses, MAC, vendor, host names, first/last seen and query counts.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |

## list_domain_rules

Exact and regex allow/deny rules, optionally filtered by type (allow|deny) and kind (exact|regex).

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `kind` | string |  | exact or regex (default: both) |
| `type` | string |  | allow or deny (default: both) |

## list_instances

Configured Pi-hole instances with their version and blocking state. Never returns secrets.

**Kind:** read-only

_No arguments._

## network_health

Health check of Pi-hole and its DNS service: host load/memory/temperature, FTL diagnostics, upstream latency and diversity, cache/NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL rates, DNSSEC failures, available updates, and devices that may be bypassing Pi-hole. Returns findings with metrics.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Window for upstream statistics and DNSSEC failures (default 24h); cache/NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL rates always use the live last 24h |

## query_timeline

Query counts over time (total/blocked/cached/forwarded), optionally for one device.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket` | string |  | Bucket size, e.g. 10m, 1h, 1d (default depends on the window) |
| `client` | string |  | Only this device (IP or name); computed from the query log |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 24h, 7d (default 24h) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |

## remove_blocklist

Unsubscribe from a block list. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | yes | URL of the installed list to remove |
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |

## remove_domain_rule

Delete an allow/deny rule. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `domain` | string | yes | Domain or regex exactly as stored |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `kind` | string |  | exact (default) or regex |
| `type` | string | yes | allow or deny |

## search_queries

Raw query-log entries with filters; paginate with the returned next_cursor. Limit ≤ 500.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | string |  | Device IP or name |
| `cursor` | integer |  | Cursor from a previous call's next_cursor to get the next page |
| `domain` | string |  | Domain filter (* wildcards supported by Pi-hole) |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `limit` | integer |  | Entries to return (1-500, default 100) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 1h, 24h (default 24h) |
| `status` | string |  | Query status, e.g. GRAVITY, FORWARDED, CACHE, DENYLIST, REGEX |
| `type` | string |  | Query type, e.g. A, AAAA, HTTPS |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |
| `upstream` | string |  | Upstream server filter |

## set_blocking

Enable or disable DNS blocking globally, optionally for a limited time. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | true = turn blocking on, false = turn it off |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `timer_seconds` | integer |  | Revert after this many seconds (strongly recommended when disabling) |

## set_blocklist_enabled

Enable or disable an installed block list without removing it. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | yes | URL of the installed list |
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | true to enable, false to disable |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |

## suggest_improvements

Ranked evidence for improving ad blocking and the network: frequently allowed domains that look like ads/trackers, devices with unusually high block ratios, block-list problems, well-known lists that are not installed, and health issues. The server provides evidence; you write the advice.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Window of traffic to analyze (default 7d) |

## top_clients

Busiest devices, or the devices with the most blocked queries.

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocked` | boolean |  | true = rank by blocked queries instead of total queries |
| `count` | integer |  | How many devices (1-100, default 10) |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 24h, 7d (default 24h) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |

## top_domains

Most queried or most blocked domains in a window. With 'client' set, ranks that device's domains (computed from the query log).

**Kind:** read-only

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocked` | boolean |  | true = most blocked domains; false = most queried allowed domains |
| `client` | string |  | Only this device (IP or name); computed from the query log |
| `count` | integer |  | How many domains (1-100, default 10) |
| `from` | string |  | Window start, RFC3339 |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
| `period` | string |  | Look-back window, e.g. 24h, 7d (default 24h) |
| `until` | string |  | Window end, RFC3339 |

## update_gravity

Download all block lists and rebuild the gravity database. Can take minutes and is CPU/IO heavy on small devices; streams progress. TWO-STEP: call without confirm_token to get a preview and a token (nothing changes); show the preview to the user and call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token only after they agree.

**Kind:** **writes**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm_token` | string |  | Token from the preview call; omit to get a preview |
| `instance` | string |  | Pi-hole instance name (default: the first configured instance) |
